premise.title: The Slumbering Serpent of Sarkesh
premise.regionDescription: A sinister southern kingdom of brooding black stone pyramids, ophidian sorcery, lotus incense, and serpent worship.
premise.logline: In the shadow of a forgotten black obsidian tomb on the Sarkeshian border, Korvath breaches a serpent cult's crypt to claim the Blood-Ruby of Sarkath, rescuing the captive desert dancer Natari while awakening and sundering an elder titan wyrm.
themes: Barbarism vs. Decadence (civilized sorcery and luxury rot; the barbarian survives on raw instinct, iron will, and cold steel)
Classic Sword-and-Sorcery Pulp (bronze scale bikinis, lotus smoke, sacrificial altars, severed armor, and cosmic dread)
Visceral Physicality & Iron Law (steel, muscle, swift reflexes, and unyielding grit overcome supernatural corruption)

beats.name: The Windswept Ruins
beats.summary: Korvath treks across the crimson-baked dunes of Sarkesh, approaching a monolithic black pyramid half-buried in sand beneath a bleeding blood-orange sunset.

beats.name: Eyes in the Dust
beats.summary: Korvath kneels beside fresh sand tracks, hand resting on the hilt of his heavy broadsword, senses alert to the scent of burnt lotus and cold steel.

beats.name: The Crypt of the Serpent
beats.summary: Korvath heaves aside an ancient shattered granite door slab carved with writhing serpent reliefs, entering the cool, pitch-black subterranean colonnade holding high a blazing torch.

beats.name: Hall of Serpent Kings
beats.summary: Korvath stalks silently through a colossal subterranean gallery lined with towering mummified statues of serpent-headed pharaohs draped in cobwebs.

beats.name: Blades of the Cult
beats.summary: Three hooded Sarkeshian cultists leap from behind towering granite pillars with curved scimitars, bronze masks gleaming in torchlight.

beats.name: The Iron Cleave
beats.summary: With pantherish speed, Korvath ducks beneath a scimitar sweep and swings his massive broadsword, cleaving through the lead cultist in a spray of blood.

beats.act: Act II: The Temple of Sarkath
beats.name: The Cavern of the Lotus
beats.summary: Korvath slips onto the high colonnade of the inner sanctuary, looking down upon smoking bronze braziers, silk cushions, and exotic maidens in revealing hammered bronze scale bikinis.

beats.act: Act II: The Temple of Sarkath
beats.name: The Captive Maiden
beats.summary: Close dramatic shot of Natari bound by gilded serpent chains near the altar, catching sight of Korvath creeping in the high shadows, her smoldering gaze filled with fierce hope.

beats.act: Act II: The Temple of Sarkath
beats.name: The Altar of Sarkath
beats.summary: High Priest Kheshat atop the dais raises his carved ebony cobra staff, chanting over a massive altar drenched in swirling emerald sorcerous fire.

beats.act: Act II: The Temple of Sarkath
beats.name: The Barbarian Charge
beats.summary: Korvath leaps down from the colonnade, broadsword roaring through the air, hurling his flaming torch into the sacrificial altar in a shower of sparks.

beats.act: Act II: The Temple of Sarkath
beats.name: Awakening of the Shadow
beats.summary: From a deep abyss behind the altar, an enormous prehistoric serpentine monstrosity with emerald-scaled coils and glowing crimson eyes rises, casting a colossal shadow.

beats.act: Act II: The Temple of Sarkath
beats.name: Wrath of the Titan
beats.summary: The colossal serpent lashes its massive tail, shattering ancient granite temple columns and sending stone blocks crashing down as maidens scramble for cover.

beats.act: Act II: The Temple of Sarkath
beats.name: Poetic Justice
beats.summary: High Priest Kheshat frantically holds up his serpent staff to command the beast, but the titan serpent strikes downward, snapping Kheshat in its massive venomous maw.

beats.name: Laughing at Doom
beats.summary: While civilized men would fall to their knees in paralyzed terror, Korvath bares his teeth in a savage warrior grin, tightening his grip on his notched blade.

beats.name: Venom and Stone
beats.summary: The serpent strikes downward with open jaws dripping pale venom; Korvath dives in a lightning roll, the fangs shattering the stone floor inches from his boots.

beats.name: The Fatal Leap
beats.summary: Korvath leaps from an altar column into midair, driving his broadsword downward between the monster's armored skull plates.

beats.name: Death Agony of the Beast
beats.summary: The colossal serpent thrashes in its death throes, crashing down upon the altar dais as the subterranean temple roof gives way in a roar of tumbling stone.

beats.name: Severing the Chains
beats.summary: Amid falling rubble, Korvath slices Natari's chains with a swift broadsword stroke and snatches the glowing Blood-Ruby of Sarkath from the altar.

beats.name: Escape into the Blinding Light
beats.summary: Korvath and Natari leap through the crumbling pyramid entrance into the blazing desert sun just as the ancient portal collapses in an explosion of sand and dust.

beats.name: The Crimson Dawn
beats.summary: Korvath stands triumphant atop a high desert dune, broadsword resting over his scarred shoulder, ruby amulet in hand, with the stunning Natari beside him gazing across the wild horizon.
